timing_measurement: Cumulative completed preprocessing/merge wall seconds across saved progress; excludes downloads, hashing, loading, checkpoint I/O and time lost after the last checkpoint. Checkpoint seconds include sequence snapshot construction and serialization/copy/readback but exclude cleanup and completion-record publication.
memory_measurement: Max sampled sum of parent and descendant RSS every 0.1s across saved sessions. May miss brief peaks, double-count shared pages; excludes checkpoint loading. Inspect memory_sampling_errors. Not an exact peak.
